content: {"answerable": true, "answer": "Newcomers can apply for benefit payments before they file their first tax return, using form RC151 or form RC66 [s10-c500-000]. A new resident without children applies with form RC151, or online through the CRA web form [s10-c500-000]. New residents without children fill out form RC151 and send it, or use the online web form, before filing their first return [s16-c500-000]. New residents with children under 19 apply for the Canada child benefit with form RC66, which also applies them for the groceries benefit, and send the form by mail with proof of birth for each child [s16-c500-000]. A single person can receive up to $679 a year from the Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit [s10-c500-000]."}
